mrd.text: New Phyrexia begins as Argentum, a world Karn creates from an existing desolate space and leaves in Memnarch's control, and Memnarch transforms it into Mirrodin.
Memnarch becomes addicted to blinkmoth serum and blocks Karn from the plane, and Karn's leaked Phyrexian oil corrupts both Memnarch and Mirrodin, giving rise to New Phyrexia under five praetors.
Mirrodin is compleated into New Phyrexia, while a Mirran resistance uses hoverguards as spies against the Phyrexians.

fut.text: Mirrodin falls to the Phyrexians and becomes New Phyrexia, and Elesh Norn seizes power over the red and black factions.

nph.text: New Phyrexia is the world once named Argentum, then Mirrodin, transformed again and given a third name after Phyrexia's victory.
Exposed to the planar core's mana, Phyrexia grows rapidly and divides into five mana-aligned factions, each led by a praetor, and the Phyrexians take over the plane and drive the Mirrans into hiding.
Elesh Norn takes over Urabrask's and Sheoldred's domains and is crowned, and Koth leads the Mirrans into new nomadic groups, while the Resistance heals Karn through Venser's sacrifice.

one.text: In Phyrexia: All Will Be One, New Phyrexia is a plane whose engineers have remodeled Mirrodin's two layers into nine, and its planar defenses scatter the planeswalker strike team on arrival because Elesh Norn knew they were coming.
Norn overwhelms Sheoldred's and Urabrask's forces and becomes the dominant praetor, the Mother of Machines, and she welcomes Karn back as Father of Machines and introduces him to Realmbreaker.
Elspeth takes a detonating Sylex off New Phyrexia, and the covert mission ends in failure.

mom.text: In March of the Machine, Elesh Norn expands her reach and brings New Phyrexia to the other planes, while Chandra and Wrenn arrive to find Mirran survivors under Koth and Melira beneath the vast Invasion Tree.

Wrenn bonds with Realmbreaker, naming it Eight, and together they find Zhalfir and swap its place with New Phyrexia's, while Jin-Gitaxias, Vorinclex and Elesh Norn are slain and Urabrask is left the only living praetor.
As New Phyrexia phases out of existence, glistening oil across the Multiverse is cut off from its source, felling the compleated invaders.
